assessment: This paper reports a fundamental set of results describing the activation of nuclear receptors. The evidence to support the relationship between function and ligand-induced shift in the conformational ensembles is based on a compelling combination of experimental and computational approaches. The manuscript has implications for fully understanding how perturbation of the conformational ensembles of proteins, in general, orchestrates function. The findings will be of interest to a broad audience in biochemistry and structural, molecular, and evolutionary biology.
